title: The celestial greenhouse
alt: A starry blue greenhouse with luminous orchids and a reflecting pool.
description: An Art Nouveau night interior with detailed botanical forms and reflective water.
prompt: A magnificent Art Nouveau greenhouse under a starry sky. Curved bronze ribs hold blue glass panels, luminous orchids and ferns fill raised beds, a central shallow reflecting pool mirrors an arched ceiling, and warm lanterns lead through clearly connected walkways. Refined architectural fantasy photography, rich emerald, bronze and midnight blue, lush believable plant anatomy, no people or writing.
